# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.5

Version 1.4.5 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.4

- **The autosave saves a new town too.** Important fix: with earlier versions, a new town was lost if it was never
  saved at the gyroid.
  - **The problem:** the autosave wrote only into the town file already on the memory card. The game makes that
    file at the town's first save at the gyroid. A player who trusted the autosave and quit after Nook's part-time
    job, without saving at the gyroid, had nothing on the card and started over.
  - **The fix:** when the town has no file yet, the autosave makes its first save the way the gyroid does, which
    creates the file, and then saves as usual. It starts when the gyroid itself would save: on the first day, once
    you have met a villager. A notice says when the town has been saved for the first time.
- **Settings → Gameplay → Town data → Delete town...** Since every town is now saved, quitting without saving no
  longer starts over. This option is how to start a new game:
  - It shows the town on each memory card, with its players, and asks once more.
  - It deletes the chosen town and restarts the game, which then begins with a new game.
  - This cannot be undone. The NES games' saves are kept.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.5 can be in the same room.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.5-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.5-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.5-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.5-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- The same scripted new game was run with the old and the new behavior (Linux): the opening, the house, a hello to
  a villager next door, a wait outdoors, then quitting without saving at the gyroid.
  - **Before:** every autosave said "not now" and the memory card stayed empty, so the next start was a new game.
  - **After:** the first autosave after the hello made the town file, the next ones and the one on quitting
    saved into it, and loading it put the player in front of their house in that town.
- The delete option, through the menu with mouse clicks (Linux): it listed the town on card A with its player,
  asked to confirm, deleted the town file (the NES save stayed), and restarted. The restarted game found no town.
- All unit tests pass. The decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.5, versionCode 10405).

## Known limitations

- Until you have met a villager on the first day, nothing is saved: the game itself does not allow saving then.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
